title: Research organisation to declared domain (conceptual relationship bundle)
identifier_representations: From roles: ROR ID, schema domains
reason: Direction m1-ror → m1-domain. Expected cardinality: organisation may declare several domains; reverse uniqueness must be measured. Unresolved compatibility, no universal organisational identity claim.
practical_value: ROR schema offers publisher-asserted domain associations, stronger than inferring organisation from arbitrary website URL. Exact current schema, record version and association quality still need dataset verification.
